verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents that it classifies every product into a category (docs-8), computes tax via a rate/estimate endpoint (docs-9), and creates a 'permanent record' of each synced transaction (docs-19), plus APIs to list nexuses (docs-11) and filings (docs-13). However there is no explicit documentation of a per-transaction audit trail that retains and exposes the specific rate, rule citation, and address-resolution logic used, nor an explicit export/report feature for audit purposes. Missing for 10: documented per-transaction breakdown of applied rate/rule/jurisdiction resolution, and a dedicated audit-export or compliance-report endpoint/UI.
